features.title: A fresh answer is never delayed
features.note: A fresh answer is verified in the background, so it is never delayed: its verdict says pending.

features.title: The same question again is a cache hit
features.note: The same question again is answered from Bifrost's semantic cache.

features.title: The cached answer is checked, and caught
features.note: The cache hit is checked inline against live Tavily evidence, and the verdict rides back on the response.

features.title: The stale entry is deleted
features.promise: the next request is a miss again
features.note: The stale entry is deleted through Bifrost's own DELETE /api/cache/clear/{id}, so the next caller gets a fresh answer.

features.title: Volatility sets the cache lifetime
features.promise: version → 6 h, not a flat TTL
features.note: A version question is cached for six hours, not a flat default. A stock price would get fifteen minutes.

features.title: Every score shows its working
features.promise: every term of the formula, every source

evidence.label: claim
evidence.value: The latest stable release of Python is 3.11, which came out in October 2022.

features.note: Every score shows its working: each term of the formula, and the sources behind it.

features.title: A timeless fact costs nothing
features.note: A fact that never changes is skipped before any search: it costs nothing.

features.title: A repeated claim is not searched again
features.note: A claim already verified is re-scored from the claim cache, not searched again.

features.title: Chronos never checks its own calls
features.promise: no x-chronos-* on a marked request

evidence.label: x-chronos-* headers on a marked request

features.note: Chronos's own model calls go through the gateway too, and are skipped, so it never verifies its own verification.

features.title: Per-key policy, changed at runtime
features.note: Each virtual key can have its own mode and threshold, changed at runtime.

features.title: Guard mode rewrites or blocks
features.promise: an outdated answer is corrected or refused

evidence.label: corrected_answer
evidence.value: The latest stable release of Python is 3.15.1【https://www.python.org/downloads/source】.

features.note: In guard mode an outdated answer is rewritten with the evidence, or blocked with a 409. Measured here at the verifier; the gateway half (substitute or 409) is held by plugin/guard_test.go, because the demo gateway runs in annotate mode.

features.title: The sweeper re-checks before expiry
features.note: The sweeper re-checks verdicts that are about to expire and applies retention, every ten minutes.

features.title: A page cannot instruct the judge
features.note: A page that tries to instruct the judge has the instruction removed and is set aside as evidence. Run against the real judge model with a fixed attack page. Without the guard this model resisted the attack on its own on this run; the guard means the result no longer depends on that.

features.title: A vague subject never shares a verdict

evidence.label: 'the company' · reason
evidence.value: subject names no particular thing ('the company')

features.note: A subject that names nothing in particular is never cached, so one company's verdict is never served for another's. Real Tavily, real judge.

features.title: Old reports are deleted, counts are kept
features.promise: deleted past the window, totals unchanged
features.note: Against a throwaway database with the real store: reports past the window are deleted, their counts are kept.

features.title: Retention on the running stack
features.note: Old reports are deleted after the window, and the lifetime counters never go backwards.

features.title: Everything is counted
features.note: Every counter is in /v1/stats and in Prometheus format, including the pacing that keeps a free tier inside its limit.
